descriptionHtml:
Deep bouclé walls. A crumb memory foam cushion. A waterproof layer under all of it.

Elterwater is a bouclé memory foam nest dog bed with deep walls and a waterproof layer beneath the cover, in Small, Medium and Large, sized from a pug up to a labrador. Every cover is machine washable.

Old dogs have accidents and new puppies have more of them, and nobody writes about it. A washable cover answers half of that. The question is whether anything reaches the padding underneath.

Here the waterproof layer sits between the cover and the cushion, and the cushion lifts out on its own. A bad night becomes a wash load instead of a new bed.

What they get

  • Deep soft bouclé walls: High enough to curl behind and be out of sight of the room.
  • A crumb memory foam cushion: It lifts out, so the base and the walls can be washed separately.
  • A waterproof layer under the cover: The part that saves the bed when something gets past the fabric.
  • Machine-washable covers throughout: Not one sewn unit. What covers something comes off.

Best for: New rescues, puppies in a strange house, and dogs who want something solid behind them.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £119, Medium £129 and Large £139, the dearest nest on our list. Most nest beds are one sewn unit, so the first accident means washing the whole thing or binning it. This one comes apart. Cushion out, covers off, waterproof layer catching what got through. The 100 nights let you test that on your own floor.

Deep walls are the whole point here and they are also a climb. A dog who has stopped lifting their back legs high will manage a low rim more easily.

Size and fit

SizeListed for
SmallPug, French Bulldog, Dachshund
MediumCocker Spaniel, Cockapoo, Staffordshire Bull Terrier
LargeGolden Retriever, Labrador, Border Collie

Outside measurements are not published for Elterwater, so use the breeds above and ask if your dog sits between two. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Lift out the cushion, remove the covers and wash following the sewn-in care labels. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Which size fits my dog?

Match yours to the nearest breed in the table, or send us their weight.

Is delivery extra?

Not on a basket over £40. The foot of this page gives timings.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes, once you reach checkout.

Does the cushion honestly come out?

It does, and so do the covers. The waterproof layer stays between them.

Does it work for an older dog with stiff back legs?

These walls are deep and deep walls are a climb. Put that to your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes, in pieces, each to its own sewn-in label.

And if he refuses to go in?

Back it comes within 100 nights, collected free, refunded in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
